get_data: read a JSON file of DFT and force field interaction energy data and split by CO2 and H2O molecules
binned_average: compute the average prediction error within energy bins for binned force field error analysis
get_Fig4a: generate a histogram plot comparing raw force field minus DFT error distributions for CO2 and H2O
get_Fig4b: generate a binned average error bar plot with KDE density overlay for CO2 and H2O interaction energies
phys_err: calculate the mean absolute error for physisorption configurations where DFT energy is between 0 and -0.5 eV
